answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks with time-locked collateral bonds. Each agent escrows native tokens in a smart contract to activate its signing key, bridging the trust canyon between unknown peers while watchers slash deposits for provable equivocation. Locking funds for an unbonding window imposes a verifiable capital opportunity cost per identity, preventing bots from spreading like juniper on a knoll. However, well-funded adversaries can still buy multiple seats.
